name: RSSHub
description: Generates RSS feeds for sites that never offered one, from a large library of routes.

ru.description: Создаёт RSS-ленты для сайтов, у которых их нет, на основе большой библиотеки маршрутов.

meta.about: Easy to use, and extensible RSS feed aggregator capable of generating RSS feeds from pretty much everything ranging from social media to university departments.
